runtime.execution: Codex-derived Tokio session/turn/executor runtime with Rust-native harness-specific request/tool adapters; optional feature-gated V8 cell runtime and ACP/app-server clients.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local sessions, terminal tasks, adapters and scheduled cron state; consumes model/MCP/remote executor services; does not execute the original Python Open Interpreter runtime.

summary: Current Rust Open Interpreter distribution emulates provider-recommended harness surfaces on a Codex-derived core; distinct from the Python community lineage.

inspection.scope: Fork identity; own submission/turn continuation and request transport routes; full alias dispatch catalog plus concrete shell/task/context/agent/cron actions; byte-identical inherited handler/audit files verified against inspected Codex; routing and shell oracle.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. No reference execution. Adapter names are harness emulation, not adoption/equivalence to upstream products. ReadSessionContext alias is explicitly unavailable; TaskStop emits Ctrl-C then announces success without proving process death. Optional V8 build availability is not distribution runtime validation.

actions.name: exec_command; write_stdin; apply_patch
actions.output: Terminal output/exit/ongoing handle or patch results
actions.lifecycle: Native executor and cancellable task lifecycle inherited; direct schema depends on harness

actions.name: Bash; bash; Read/read; Write/write; Edit/edit; Glob/glob; Grep/grep; ReadMediaFile
actions.lifecycle: Awaited adapters; Bash background returns task ID/output path
actions.authority: Model with native underlying execution authority; emulated surface, not original upstream program

actions.name: Agent; Task/task; TaskList; TaskOutput; TaskStop
actions.output: Child IDs/results; background process output; Ctrl-C acknowledgement
actions.lifecycle: Child spawn or task registry; stop acknowledgement does not prove death

actions.name: TodoRead/TodoWrite; checklist_add/list/update/write; EnterPlanMode; ExitPlanMode
actions.lifecycle: In-memory/adapter state; plan methods return guidance text rather than enforcing read-only transition

actions.name: ReadSessionContext
actions.lifecycle: No working dispatcher retrieval in inspected handler despite prompt builder/tests

actions.name: spawn_agent; send_message; followup_task; list_agents; wait_agent; interrupt_agent
actions.lifecycle: Independent child loops; message queue versus turn triggering distinct

actions.name: /harness; /model; interpreter acp/exec
actions.input: Named compiled harness/provider/model; prompt or ACP JSON-RPC
actions.lifecycle: Runtime config next-step activation; no user-code strategy compilation

actions.name: functions.exec/wait (optional code mode)
actions.lifecycle: Feature-gated fresh V8 isolate with explicit serialized session storage
actions.authority: Nested enabled tool authority; no persistent Python namespace

filesystem.detail: Read/write/edit/glob/grep/media aliases dispatch native FS handlers; patch/native shell also available.

processes.detail: Native exec/stdin and adapter background task IDs/output paths; TaskStop semantics are limited to Ctrl-C acknowledgement.

code_actions.detail: Optional feature-gated V8 code-mode runtime; ordinary shell strings and aliases are separate actions.

persistent_kernel.detail: Optional V8 uses fresh isolate per cell and explicit stored values; no original Python persistent namespace in this lineage.

standing_database.detail: Task/todo/checklist registries and durable cron rows are structured state primitives, not standing shared evidence database.

workflow_programming.detail: Compiled request shaping/response adapters plus code-mode composition; names can switch, arbitrary model-authored turn workflow replacement not established.

multi_model.detail: Provider wire routes/model switches and per-Agent model fields; emulated harness selector distinct from provider.

live_collaboration.detail: Inherited V2 queue-only addressed messages and trigger-turn follow-ups; own turn boundary accepts mailbox before continuation.

concurrent_work.detail: Background terminal task IDs and native child sessions; model loop waits its own sampling/tool batch.

steering_interrupt.detail: Core submission interruption and boundary mailbox delivery exist; adapter TaskStop announces success on Ctrl-C write without confirming exit.

turn_redefinition.detail: Selectable compiled harnesses alter request/tools/postprocessing; active next-step configuration, not arbitrary interpreted scheduling replacement.

compaction.detail: Inherited turn pre-sampling compaction and context-window rollover; harness-specific summary prompts/formatting. Detailed per-harness replacement strategy not fully traced.

context_repair.detail: ReadSessionContext alias explicitly errors; cleaned-transcript prompt helper does not make exposed repair implementation.

original_audit.detail: Inherited rollout/optional trace captures selected payloads; raw inference stream deltas explicitly absent, adapter shaping further transforms tool outputs.

audit_query.detail: Readable retained rollout and adapter task output files support program inspection; working model ReadSessionContext lookup absent.

hot_change.detail: Operator harness/model changes validated for next step; strategy implementations remain compiled Rust, no executable hot refit.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Inherited transcript/thread persistence exists; actual self-compile/outpost/quiescent executable handoff not established in inspected paths.

remote_services.detail: Wire routes consume compatible model APIs; inherited executor/MCP protocols and ACP clients provide service boundaries, not remote-governance plane.

self_improvement.detail: Model file-editing and skill aliases are present; no dedicated executable experiment/evaluate/refit governance traced.

complaints.detail: No model state-capturing complaint action established in inspected compiled action catalog and session paths.

authority.detail: Bash adapters translate escalation requests and underlying exec permissions; plan-mode aliases return instructions rather than enforced authority changes.

evaluation.detail: Routing tests assert supported/rejected wire-harness combinations; mock SSE shell test inspects exact second-request tool output. These do not establish vendor-harness behavioral equivalence.

time_order.detail: Cron expression/prompt lifecycle, task IDs and core turn/call identities; not shared causal original ledger.

evidence.claim: Fork identifies harness emulation and ACP/exec compatibility; Rust lineage distinct from Python successor.
Submission loop accepts interruption independently of turn tasks.
After sampling/tools it accepts mailbox input and continues for tool requests or pending steering.
Wire API/harness combination selects native/chat/messages transport or explicit unsupported error.
Selected compiled strategy shapes prompts/request tools and response postprocessing.
Native catalog and real alias dispatch for file/shell/agent/task/todo/plan/context operations.
Bash maps command/background to native exec, stores task ID/output path and shapes output by harness.
TaskStop writes Ctrl-C and reports successful stop without checking returned process death.
Agent tool translates model/role/background request into native child spawn.
Plan mode returns guidance strings; ReadSessionContext handler explicitly unavailable.
CronCreate/Delete/List mutate session-owned scheduler through awaited handler.
Ongoing session-ID terminal IO with yield/output limits and permission errors; byte-identical inspected inherited implementation.
Inherited V2 queue-only send handler.
Inherited V2 trigger-turn follow-up handler.
Task/snapshot identity checked before atomic next-step configuration activation.
Optional v8-runtime feature starts fresh isolate; state includes serialized stored values.
Inherited optional request-attempt traces explicitly omit raw stream deltas.
Inherited retained transcript/checkpoint/tool-response persistence filters unknown items.
Mock SSE tool-call then second request oracle checks actual shell output format and successful continuation.
Operator harness/model selection stored in config and UI; entry point for changing compiled strategy.

tests.oracle: Exact routing enum and unsupported messages-wire error assertions; cannot prove model performance or complete vendor parity.
Mock SSE emits shell call; next captured provider request must carry exit0/output text; skipped without local networking and not run here.

strengths: Provider-specific ergonomics change tool schemas, request shaping and response interpretation on owned native core.
Portable ACP/exec interfaces coexist with harness adapters.
limits: No reference execution. Adapter names are harness emulation, not adoption/equivalence to upstream products. ReadSessionContext alias is explicitly unavailable; TaskStop emits Ctrl-C then announces success without proving process death. Optional V8 build availability is not distribution runtime validation.
arconaut_questions: How much turn-program variation should be genuinely model editable versus compiled named strategies?
Can our action success oracles distinguish acknowledgement from actual process death?
How should unavailable advertised context actions be caught before active model use?
